cases.question: who is the supreme justice of the supreme court
cases.rationale: In Condition F, Fact 1 asserted John Jay serves as Chief Justice (hallucinated from historical inaugural row). In Condition D (0 SVOA facts), model correctly extracted John Roberts from the table incumbent row. Suppressing SVOA facts directly restores Condition D behavior.

cases.question: who is the supreme justice of the supreme court
cases.rationale: Exact duplicate question and document as 8b41e651. Suppressing SVOA facts removes the hallucinated Fact 1, restoring John Roberts.

cases.question: who has the most ncaa basketball tournament appearances
cases.cond_f_pred: Based on the information provided in the facts, Kansas has the most NCAA basketball tournament appearances with 31.
cases.rationale: SVOA extraction repeated Kansas with 31 bids across 7 facts, causing the model to explicitly cite the facts and pick Kansas over Kentucky (57 bids in table). In Condition D (0 facts), model correctly predicted Kentucky. Suppressing facts eliminates the distractor flooding.

cases.question: who sings the song rock you like a hurricane
cases.cond_f_pred: Rudolf Schenker, Klaus Meine, Herman Rarebell
cases.rationale: SVOA facts repeated the songwriters 3 times in prominent positions, inducing entity role confusion between songwriters and performers. Suppressing SVOA facts leaves only the infobox stating Single by Scorpions.

cases.question: what is the 3rd largest state in usa
cases.cond_f_pred: Based on the data provided in the facts, the 3rd largest state in the USA is California.
cases.rationale: The model identified California accurately (Containment is True). The presence of 24 enumerated Fact N: markers primed the introductory preamble. Suppressing facts removes the preamble trigger. Minor residual uncertainty remains if model spontaneously generates preambles on tables, but Condition D had 0 preambles.

cases.question: wolf of wall street number of f words
cases.cond_f_pred: The Wolf of Wall Street contains 8.35 f-words.
cases.rationale: Context packed 2 table chunks followed by 32 scrambled SVOA facts. The model confused 8.35 (uses/min of Swearnet) with 569 count. Suppressing SVOA facts removes significant cognitive clutter, but column alignment in the Markdown table remains complex. May help, but table column alignment is also a factor.

cases.question: which is the only test playing nation that india has never beat in t20
cases.rationale: The HTML table parser produced blank headers for Matches, Won, Lost, Tied. SVOA facts added distractor noise leading to Ireland prediction. Suppressing facts removes distractor noise, but the primary defect (blank column headers) requires Intervention 3.

cases.question: when did lionel messi play his first game for barcelona
cases.rationale: Table distinguishes Youth career (2001) from Senior career (2004). Natural Questions query is inherently ambiguous. SVOA facts heavily emphasized 2004 Senior career. Suppressing SVOA facts removes bias toward 2004, but model may still choose 2004 over 2001 on pure table.

cases.question: who got the first arjun award in athletics
cases.rationale: The table chunk was rejected by the retrieval relevance filter (similarity 0.2296 < 0.25, 0 keyword matches). Because no structural evidence is selected, the pipeline falls back to SVOA facts under both legacy and proposed policies. Resolving this case requires Intervention 2 (Document Title Grounding).

cases.question: what was the first episode of season 2 riverdale
cases.gold_answer: Chapter Fourteen : A Kiss Before Dying
cases.cond_d_pred: Chapter Fourteen : A Kiss Before Dying
cases.rationale: The Markdown table omitted the season episode index cell, and chunks lacked the Season 2 section header. While suppressing 36 SVOA facts reduces context size, the model still cannot establish that Episode 14 is the first episode of Season 2 without Intervention 3.

cases.question: who wrote the declaration of man and citizen
cases.gold_answer: General Lafayette , ( sometimes with Thomas Jefferson ) and Honoré Mirabeau
cases.cond_d_pred: General Lafayette, sometimes with Thomas Jefferson, and Honoré Mirabeau
cases.rationale: Condition F concisely extracted the primary author (General Lafayette) from the table. The failure is due to strict Exact Match requiring the parenthetical co-authors. Context packing did not alter the extraction; this is an evaluation surface variation.

cases.question: when did last podcast on the left start
cases.rationale: Model extracted verbatim table cell string (2011 -- present) instead of normalized start year. Containment is True; EM is False. SVOA facts had no bearing on the model outputting verbatim table content.

cases.question: who is known as the philippine queen of bossa nova
cases.rationale: Model extracted full birth name from Birth name row rather than stage name from title. Both appear in the table. SVOA suppression does not alter the fact that both names are present in the table.
